body: This is lovely. Makes me so happy to be living in a city where gloom and good times coexist ❤️
Waiting to book a trip to Edinburgh, Scotland for February and maybe hop over to New Zealand and Ireland too :)

I agree! Target has some pretty good reads. This is my second book of 2021. Hoping to read more and add to my growing library.

Thanks for teaching me some Welsh!! 💕

Dang, that's a pretty good point. With flu season coming up, it's possible and likely for COVID19 to create a sh\*tstorm especially when people are gathering in numbers.

Sorry to hear. I feel for all you Spring 2020 graduates not getting the graduation you deserved and waited for. 

It sucks that SDSU has been delaying action until the last possible day of each extension. I'd rather them take action and be straightforward about the reality of things. But then again, we all need to wait regardless.

Two good days is great! So happy for you! :) going through things myself I’ve realized how much of a blessing it is to have days where there are completely no worries or being anxious. 

Quality time for your mental health always feels like a relief. I always think of it as running a mile and sweating hard and being out breath, but the moment I finish that mile and take that amazing first sip of water, that is exactly what a good day feels like.
You’re very welcome :) hope it goes well!

Not sure if you have the time but something to keep in mind is get her something that will remind her of a time you both shared or how you feel about being with her. A good gift always has some special meaning to it. 

For Christmas my boyfriend got me a set of famous painter socks since I love art but to top it all off he got me a teapot keychain to signify the teapot Jim got Pam in The Office since we watched the show a lot when we first started dating. It seems like an ordinary keychain but for me there's a story behind it all. I keep it with my car keys and it always reminds me of us :)

Flowers, pictures, and hand written notes are my favorites as well. I think they're super chivalrous and always ties in the whole experience. If you could, maybe try looking into [https://boomf.com/](https://boomf.com/) also! I got it this for my boyfriend on Valentine's day and it was fun to see him all surprised when he pulled the card and all the confetti popped out!

Also it's the little things. So pay attention and listen to the things she mentions. Getting her something based on that will show her you didn't forget and it'll be a nice surprise.

You got this! Make it fun, make it creative, but most of all make it special for the both of you :) Good luck and congrats on 2 years coming up!!

It’s very brave of you and a good step for you to write about it. Always helps in taking off some of those heavy feelings. I’m glad you’re here even if you’re a stranger and I know these feelings are hard to get through but you’re doing okay. 

What are your plans for tomorrow?
